findings: PR972 adds score_token_end and sequence_token_end output pointers to parse_format3_row and parse_row_single_pass.
Its strict parser sets those outputs when it scans the score and non-null sequence; the fused caller initializes both to zero and consumes them directly in parse_int32_token instead of rescanning.
The numeric suffix candidate returns early after expression/reading and a complete suffix equality proof, before those numeric-scan assignments would execute in a naive combination.
Copying current TermRowMeta fields alone cannot populate the new token-end outputs. A naive textual combination would leave them at zero on successful suffix reuse.
decision: Do not mix the candidates or treat their independent evidence as combined qualification. A future composition must establish the numeric token-end outputs on every reuse path and undergo separate correctness and performance qualification.
